item.description: If your app has a model read documents, emails or web pages, anyone who writes in them can try to give it instructions. We ran 25 attacks against four current models with each defense on and off. Labels cut attack emails, but only checking every tool call with Armor stopped all of them.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进 / Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
item.description: The Verge 作者分析 Anthropic S-1，认为其商业模式依赖高速增长：2026 上半年营收同比增长 14 倍至 $16.3 billion，净收入留存率 900%，但不可撤销采购承诺合计 $265.6 billion，加上未开始的租赁协议 $321.4 billion 及其他协议，未来 20 年承诺至少约 $850 billion。（The Verge：AI（RSS））

item.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 LLM 从 PDF 中抽取表格 / How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
item.description: Send a PDF to a model that reads files, with a strict JSON schema for one row, and you get typed rows back, even from scans and tables that run across pages. We tested five routes on five PDFs and found two failures that return a normal response with no error, and the checks that catch them.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: Google 三季度搜索增速不及预期，投资者担忧 AI 搜索变现拖累核心业务 / Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
item.description: Google 三季度搜索收入增长约 12%，低于分析师预期的 15%，市值一度缩水最多 10%。高管 Philipp Schindler 承认 AI mode 查询的强劲增长因变现率较低产生了影响，同时公司称搜索查询年增速达五年来最高，并计划在美国及国际市场扩大聊天机器人广告项目。（The Decoder：AI News（RSS））

item.title: The Art of Loop Engineering
item.description: Agents automate real-world work, but reliable performance requires more than a good model, it requires a carefully designed harness built for specific tasks. This post explores the core agent loop, how stacking and extending loops builds more effective agents, and how to instrument each level with LangChain primitives.（LangChain Blog）
